lines: A certain day in a certain month. Tokyo Kingdom, undergroundー
Me
Whooaaa!? They're still coming!? Damn it!!
*Slash!!*
Will-o'-wisp
GR-ROOGH!!!?!
With a dodge and a slash of my ninjatoー!
Letting out a loud scream, the demonic creatureーthe Will-o'-wispーwas sliced in half and disappeared.
Me
Haah haah... Boo-ya, if I do say so myself...
While huffing and puffing, I somehow stood up straight again.
I had somehow managed to get rid of one of them.
But I couldn't relax completely yet.
Will-o'-wisp
GRR-ROOGH...
Me
(Oh man... They're popping out one after another, like always...)
These were demonic creaturesーWill-o'-wispsーthat I had previously encountered at the shop of the shady broker in Shin-Minato District.
And a swarm of them was trying to surround me while I was alone, waiting for an opening to attack me.
Me
(Damn it!! If only Hebiko or Shikanosuke were here right nowー)
I always ended up thinking something like that.
It was true that my physical abilities had improved since I had come back to life, and that I was now able to deal with weaker demonic creatures, such as Will-o'-wisps, on my own.
But nevertheless, being surrounded like this was still pretty tough.
I could get out of this predicament in no time if I had my squad mates, whose abilities and dispositions I knew thoroughlyー
It was only natural to think something like that.
Me
(Howeverー)
Hebiko and Shikanosuke were nowhere near me right now.
And insteadー
Woman
Hey, Fuma!? Stop zoning out! Don't blame me if you get eaten by a Will-o'-wisp!
A headstrong-looking woman said in an irritated tone.
Me
Yeah, yeah, I know...
I sighed and readied my ninjato.
And standing against me were countless Will-o'-wisps, looking ferocious.
ーThere was no way around it.
For now I had to work with this woman to somehow get out of this predicamentー
